Eight original 14-day photographs supplied by Mitra Ghotbi: A60_2 and B20_2.
Each set has one labelled control and three treatment photographs. JPG bytes are
unchanged from the supplied archive; only the other three sets were omitted.
The combined metadata preserves the source fungus field hm83 without asserting
its biological role. Verify treatment identities and control matching against
laboratory records. metadata_confirmed and qc_pass start FALSE.

Confirm metadata assignments before finalization. QC review is strongly advised;
unconfirmed qc_pass warns by default but does not prevent calculation. Use
require_qc=TRUE to require explicit QC approval. Pixels, spots and the four
colonies per plate are subsamples, not independent plate replicates.
